## Checklist (all changes)

- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds locally (`tsc -b` type-check passes).
- [ ] The change is focused; unrelated changes are in separate PRs.
- [ ] No patient-identifiable information is included anywhere.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or private source files are committed.

## Checklist (sample/demonstration content only)

> This repository ships **demonstration content only**. Contributions must be
> **independently written** educational examples — do not add production content
> here.

<!-- Delete this section if your PR does not touch sample content. -->

- [ ] Content is independently written from general clinical knowledge.
- [ ] No copyrighted guideline text, tables, or figures — original wording only.
- [ ] No page numbers, tables, figures, or proprietary source sections cited.
- [ ] Fictional educational scenarios only; no patient-identifiable information.
- [ ] Any AI-assisted drafting was personally reviewed for accuracy.
- [ ] Conflicts of interest disclosed (or "none").
- [ ] I hold the rights to this content and agree to license it under CC BY 4.0.
